title: BacRootFit: predicting bacterial root colonization-associated genes using protein language models — software
description: Manuscript-aligned BacRootFit software, source provenance, portable prediction/training/evaluation commands and a static evidence browser. Versioned data, raw ProtT5 means, development/deployment model bundles and stored experiment results are supplied as separately checksummed release assets. Code is MIT; original curation contributions are CC BY 4.0; third-party terms remain applicable.
